therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Chromatin remodeling and transcriptional regulation to induce apoptosis in myeloma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Relapsed or relapsed-and-refractory multiple myeloma patients

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional panobinostat exposure: Cmax 14.30 ng/mL (20mg TIW), 14.12 ng/mL (20mg BIW), 6.13 ng/mL (10mg TIW)
subgroup_findings: Exposure-response relationship demonstrated between panobinostat Cmax and ORR
Higher doses associated with increased efficacy and toxicity
safety_signals: Cardiac events including atrial fibrillation, cardiac failure
results.dose_information: Panobinostat 20mg or 10mg with dose reductions to 15mg or 10mg; given TIW (3 times weekly) or BIW (2 times weekly) in combination with bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 and dexamethasone

context.comparator: None - single arm dose-finding study with three different panobinostat dosing regimens
context.duration: Up to 5.2 years follow-up, with primary endpoint assessed up to 168 days (8 cycles)
